defs.def: at the end of a period of time or a series of events 最后；终于

ex.s: Eventually, she fell asleep.
ex.t: 最终，她睡着了。

ex.s: Eventually, my brother decided to leave rather than force the issue.
ex.t: 许多猫会在外面找到随机物品并把它们带回来给主人。

ex.s: Even the most engaged and committed audience will eventually get bored.
ex.t: 骑行是最经济、最可持续、最有趣的探索这座城市的方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: Eventually, researchers made a prediction that progressive warming during the 21st and 22nd centuries would dry out the Arctic, and lakes would begin to shrink.
ex.t: 我把车停在农场外，走过一座显然已经多年未用的挤奶房。

ex.s: “If you eat too much or do too much of anything, you’re going to suffer eventually,” he said.
ex.t: "如果你吃得太多或做任何事过度，你最终会受苦的，"他说。

ex.s: By learning when to ask for help, I eventually found myself on the way to becoming an independent scientist.
ex.t: 通过学会何时寻求帮助，我终于踏上了成为独立科学家的道路。

ex.s: Eventually, I got up in the dark and drove to the meeting spot.
ex.t: 最终，我在黑暗中起床开车去了集合地点。

ex.s: 9. _________ several adjustments to the design for two months, the engineer eventually succeeded in building a highly efficient system.
ex.t: 承认弱点

ex.s: When she retired from dancing and her sons eventually flew the nest, she decided it was time to take the plunge.
ex.t: 当她从舞蹈事业退休，儿子们最终离巢后，她决定是时候迈出这一步了。

ex.s: After taking a degree at Chichester University in Related Arts, Ginni began to travel the world, eventually getting work teaching English in Japan and Chile.
ex.t: 在Chichester大学获得相关艺术学位后，Ginni开始周游世界，最终在日本和智利找到了教英语的工作。

ex.s: Eventually, Ms Burdeyney learned about plans for an eye research, ___23___ at Tel Aviv University in Israel.
ex.t: 最终，Burdeyney女士得知了一项眼研究计划，___23___位于以色列特拉维夫大学。

ex.s: As he went on to share his concept with others, the idea soon took off in India and other countries before eventually reaching Europe, where it became popular in places like France, Belgium and the Netherlands.
ex.t: 当他与其他人分享他的概念时，这个想法很快在印度和其他国家流行起来，最终传到欧洲，在法国、比利时和荷兰等地受欢迎。

ex.s: Eventually, the man ____13____ (catch) up with her, and he was only trying to return her wallet!
ex.t: 最终，那个男人____13____ (catch)追上了她，他只是想把钱包还给她！

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日那天我们收集物品的所有努力终于汇聚在一起．当我看到我们收集的各种物资时我突然意识到我们当天要制作的每一个包裹最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中．在过去四个月里我从没想过项目完成后我会是什么感觉．在制作包裹的过程中我意识到我已经忘记了它背后的真正意义．我只把它当作又一个学校项目而且我想在这个项目上取得好成绩．当包裹完成准备运往海外时那种温暖的感觉是我永远不会忘记的．

ex.s: It is easier to avoid a discussion，but risking talking about it may eventually lead to a better outcome．
ex.t: 避免讨论比较容易但冒险谈论它最终可能会导致更好的结果。

ex.s: Are you hoping that eventually you will feel empowered because your life is better than theirs?
ex.t: 要知道，你的人生是你自己的；你是这个世界上独一无二的你。

ex.s: Ehlers eventually succeeded in coaxing the animal to him.
ex.t: 埃勒斯终于成功地把那只小狗哄到了身边。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: C．通过将遭到破坏的生态系统恢复正常。

ex.s: But eventually Henry Ford would build fifteen million of them.
ex.t: 现代美国诞生在路上，诞生在方向盘后。

ex.s: 3．（1分）At first Robert wouldn't let his daughter go diving， but eventually he               as she was so confident about her skills．（  ）
ex.t: A．自从 B．好像

ex.s: The Habima is the centre of Hebrew-language theatre worldwide, Founded in Moscow after the 1905 revolution, the company eventually settled in Tel Aviv in the late 1920s.
ex.t: 哈比马是全球希伯来语戏剧的中心，成立于1905年革命后的莫斯科，该公司于20世纪20年代末最终定居特拉维夫。

ex.s: The Habima is the centre of Hebrew-language theatre worldwide ,Founded in Moscow after the 1905 revolution, the company eventually settled in Tel Aviv in the late 1920s,Since 1958, they have been recognised as the national theatre of Israel .This production of Shakespeare’s The Merchant of Venice marks their first visit to the UK.
ex.t: C.5月22日周二。

ex.s: Eventually, it manages to reach the places where it will spend the winter.
ex.t: 最终，它设法抵达了将要过冬的地方。

ex.s: We got lost a few times even with the help of GPS, but eventually we managed to cross the Rocky Mountains.
ex.t: 即使有 GPS 的帮助，我们也有好几次迷路了，但我们最终设法穿越了落基山脉。

ex.s: Eventually, realising / realised that every emotion has a role, Joy understands it is okay for Riley to feel sad sometimes.
ex.t: 最终，快乐意识到 / 意识到了每一种情绪都有自己的作用，她明白了莱莉有时感到悲伤也是可以的。

ex.s: After repeating this process a few times, they eventually found the ideal distance where they could feel warm while managing not to hurt each other.
ex.t: 在重复这个过程几次之后，他们最终找到了一个理想的距离，既能感受到温暖，又能做到不伤害对方。

ex.s: Due to Han Gan’s natural talent and years of hard work, he was eventually chosen to serve Emperor Xuanzong in the royal palace.
ex.t: 由于韩干的天赋和多年的刻苦努力，他最终被选中进入皇宫为唐玄宗效力。
